supersedes.definition: [min, max] of max_position_diff_m_over_time over 4 single-env GPU replays per seed (docs/evidence/rl_ready/p1_0_baseline_001.json l3_band)
supersedes.reason: a new run from the same distribution falls outside the range of 4 earlier runs with probability 2/(4+1) = 40 %; reported in P1-0 as 'reported, not scored'

metric.name: max_position_diff_m_over_time
metric.definition: max over the Native samples (every 10 control steps = 0.2 s, t = 0 .. 24 s, 121 samples incl. t = 0) of the max over particles of the Euclidean distance between the replay and the Native WORLD particle positions (robotic_cutting_sim.rl.replay.compare_sample, max_position_diff_m); unit m
metric.episode: full 1200-step WP-17 replay (measured edge pose, resolved cut digit, measured pad boxes), workload A

second_scored_statistic.name: final_max_position_diff_m
second_scored_statistic.definition: max over particles of the Euclidean distance between the replay and the Native WORLD positions at the final Native sample (t = 24 s, control step 1200); unit m

reference_sample.material: frozen single LiveCuttingMaterial (tlmpm_v7_2, law 8, v7_2 optimizations, one 200-substep CUDA graph), material seed 42
reference_sample.gpu_assignment: two chains (GPU 0 and GPU 1, RTX 5090, driver 570.211.01), each alternating seed 512 / 15, 5 + 5 runs per chain; each chain under its rcs_rl_runner gpu<N>.lock
reference_sample.inclusion: every run with status COMPLETE, 1200 steps and invariants PASS is used; no run is dropped for its metric value. A crashed or truncated process is preserved and replaced by one extra run (at most 2 extras per seed); if fewer than 10 valid runs per seed remain, the band for that seed is INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERSAMPLED
reference_sample.excluded_from_reference: P1-0 band runs, p1_2_single_ref_s512_001 and every batched run: they are re-classified as held-out runs, never used to derive the band

tolerance.upper_m: exp(mean(y) + k * sd(y)), sd with ddof = 1
tolerance.k: t_{1 - alpha, n - 1} * sqrt(1 + 1 / n)  (Student t quantile; prediction bound for one new run)
tolerance.false_reject_rate_assumptions: the new run is exchangeable with the reference runs (same seed, same distribution) and ln(metric) is normal
tolerance.lower_m_descriptive_only: exp(mean(y) - k * sd(y)); a run below it is BELOW_REFERENCE (smaller deviation from Native than the frozen single env spread), reported, never a failure
tolerance.normality_check: Shapiro-Wilk on y per seed, reported. If p < 0.01 the parametric bound is not used: upper_m = max(reference) with nominal one-sided false-reject rate 1 / (n + 1), recorded as fallback_empirical_max
tolerance.rounding: no rounding of the bound; values stored as float

classification_per_run.INVALID_PROCESS: the run is labelled invalid by its own evidence (e.g. INVALID_MULTI_GRID_PROCESS); value reported, not scored
classification_per_run.NO_POSITION_DATA: the run recorded no comparison against the Native samples
classification_per_run.NOT_APPLICABLE: smoke / truncated / cold-cache runs shorter than the full episode

aggregate_per_run_set.rule: a set of n scored runs (WITHIN or OUTSIDE) of one package is MET if the number of OUTSIDE runs r <= c(n), with c(n) the smallest c such that P[Binomial(n, alpha) > c] <= 0.05; else NOT_MET

scope: the band is a statistical regression check of GPU float-atomic run-to-run position spread against Native. It is not a physical tolerance; final codes, labelled counts and the frozen evaluator remain independent pass/fail criteria
values_file: configs/rl_benchmark/position_band_v2_reference.json (schema rcs_rl_position_band_reference_v2, written by scripts/rl_ready/make_position_band_v2.py from the reference runs)
consumer_api: robotic_cutting_sim.rl.position_band: load_reference(), classify(seed, metric_m), critical_count(n, alpha), aggregate(classes)
